theorem bbolt.Bucket.ForEach.wp_proof (hcur : bbolt.Bucket.Cursor.spec) (hfst :
    bbolt.Cursor.First.spec) (hnx : bbolt.Cursor.Next.spec) : bbolt.Bucket.ForEach.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Bucket.ForEach.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (tx : Loc) (γ : bbolt.BoltName)
    (q : Qp) (T : bbolt.TxView) (b : Loc) (n : GoString) (m : bbolt.BktData) (fn : GoFunc) (I : Nat → IProp GF)
    (E : Nat → GoInterface → IProp GF),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        (bbolt.boltTx tx γ q T ∗
            bbolt.boltBkt tx γ b n (T.gen n) ∗
              ⌜T.cur !! n = some m⌝ ∗
                I 0 ∗
                  □
                    ∀ i k v,
                      □
                        ∀ Φ,
                          ⌜i < (bbolt.bktEnts m).length⌝ ∗
                              I i ∗ bbolt.curAt tx γ (bbolt.bktEnts m) i k v ∗ bbolt.boltTx tx γ q T -∗
                            (▷
                                ∀ err,
                                  bbolt.boltTx tx γ q T ∗
                                      (⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ I (i + 1) ∨ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ E i err) -∗
                                    Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
                              WP (((intoVal fn) (intoVal k)) (intoVal v)) {{ Φ }}) -∗
          (▷
              ∀ err,
                bbolt.boltTx tx γ q T ∗
                    (⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ I (bbolt.bktEnts m).length ∨
                      ∃ i, ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ i < (bbolt.bktEnts m).length⌝ ∗ E i err) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal
                  (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket.ty.PointerType go!"ForEach"
                    (intoVal b)))
                (intoVal fn))
              {{ Φ }}
